title: Approval of Agreement No. 47027 for Cloud Based Energy Management
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Office of the Chief Strategy and Sustainability Officer
  Approval of Agreement No. 47027 for Cloud Based Energy Management
  Tool with Abjayon, Inc. The proposed Agreement is for a term of five years,
  and an amount not to exceed $500,000.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section
  15061(b)(3).
summary: Approval of Agreement No. 47027 for Cloud Based Energy Management Tool with Abjayon, Inc., five-year term not to exceed $500,000.
